title: Edit, run preview, inspect output, stop, and restore
naturalLanguageTask: Change renderer.js so the Fiddle renders the unique text 'ActOnce Deep Chain Ready', change styles.css to give that view a dark blue background and white title, run the Fiddle, verify the launched preview shows the unique text and styling, return to the Fiddle and verify the console reports a successful run, stop the preview, then undo both files back to their original contents without saving.

setup.readyAssertion: Lynxtron Fiddle is the foreground window, no Welcome or other modal dialog is open, its unobstructed default source editors and console are visible, and no preview process is running

precondition: The default Hello Lynxtron Fiddle is unmodified, renderer.js and styles.css are available through the command palette, and the Run control is enabled

steps.prompt: The command palette search contains renderer.js and its renderer.js result is selected
The renderer.js editor visibly contains the unique text 'ActOnce Deep Chain Ready' and the replacement ReactLynx source
The command palette search contains styles.css and its styles.css result is selected
The styles.css editor visibly contains background-color #123b63, white title text, and font-size 30px
Lynxtron Fiddle indicates there are unsaved edits and styles.css contains the dark blue background and white title rules

steps.target: the Run control in the top command bar

steps.prompt: {visible: boolean, text: string | null, darkBlueBackground: boolean, whiteTitle: boolean}, inspect the newly launched Fiddle preview window and report its unique title text and requested visual styling
The parent Lynxtron Fiddle window is visible and its console contains a successful Run line with a process id or workspace path

steps.target: the Stop control in the top command bar

steps.prompt: The top command bar shows Run rather than Stop and the console reports that the preview process stopped or exited
renderer.js and styles.css are restored to the default Hello Lynxtron contents and the unsaved-edits indicator is gone

steps.target: the Stop control in the top command bar, if a preview is still running
